scope: Independent READONLY DESIGN matrix. These are normative acceptance cases, NOT executed new API or transport results.

cases.case: Batch prepare with one invalid, aliased, detached, RAB/SAB or duplicate backing
cases.required: Whole ownership graph unchanged; no partial PREPARED, new allocation, new charge or detach.

cases.case: UI/history/main-SHA still owns a reference to input
cases.required: TRANSFER_ALIASED before detach, or separately reserve/copy with distinct allocation ID; another lease close cannot erase broker hold.

cases.case: Native send succeeds, throws while all buffers attached, or partially detaches
cases.required: All detached => IN_FLIGHT with charge; all attached throw => same MAIN IDs/maps/charges; partial detach => terminate, no false rollback or resend. Attached local members await their actual local cleanup.

cases.case: Real transferred input returns with new main JS wrapper
cases.required: Validate entire expected packet, sizes, uniqueness, no known-backing conflict and authenticated current channel before atomic same-ID rebind. No registerExisting, dummy buffer or uncharged interval.

cases.case: Consumer adoption after valid return versus stale/cancelled result
cases.required: MAIN rebind precedes G1a consumer retain; category union charged before broker job ref release. Refused/stale adoption drops only this job ownership and never publishes private S.

cases.case: New remote output: reserved grant => allocate once => MATERIALIZED => RETURN or terminate
cases.required: Same pre-reserved allocation stays charged before allocation, before ACK and through return; materialization and return do not add allocations/bytes; terminal also removes unmaterialized remote grants for only that instance.
cases.gate: Separate grant acceptance before G2c use; not required for first pool/input-only primitive

cases.case: Serialized allocation/ticket IDs, forged capabilities, wrong schema, duplicate ACK
cases.required: IDs are lookup only. Private runtime records and exact Worker/channel/incarnation/nonce authenticate first. Current malformed/duplicate => fail-closed revoke/terminate; old correlation => ignore without touching newer ownership.

cases.case: Terminal old binding, slot reuse, late old ACK or retired h1 release during pending h2
cases.required: Three stable logical realm domains; new physical Worker/incarnation/nonce. Exactly-once cleanup targets old remote binding only; new request and pending main continuations remain intact.

cases.case: Native main SHA pending during worker termination, eventual success/reject/dispose
cases.required: Reserve 32 B native output before call; bind actual native AB to that ID once. Keep main preimage/output reservations until actual JS settlement despite public cancellation; dispose cannot publish late handle; two WAIT_MAIN prevents unbounded acquisition.

cases.case: Ordinary createResourceLedger and old G1a tests/defaults
cases.required: Public logical-transfer semantics and reserved/live snapshots unchanged without adapter; shared category union, auth/error priority, last-ref release and default caps remain accepted G1a.

cases.case: Two native idle slots acquired, attempt third acquire
cases.required: BUSY synchronously before copy, constructor or send. Constructor/reserve failure rolls back owned records; terminate and reacquire >32 physical incarnations uses only original three realm domains.

cases.case: Pool primitive approval versus full application/session and mixed-positive
cases.required: No source ACTIVE or full migration claim from isolated pool. G1b2 fences/drain/ingress remain separate; real arena-analyze + retained audited owner positive stays UNACCEPTED until G2c/G3. No requirement to implement them before G1b1a.
